description: Returns the full record for one reference key: citation, DOI and PMID when the site prints them (none is added), url and the link the site uses, kind, the statistics topics that cite it, the get_prevalence entry ids built from it, and a license note. Any of the 93 keys in the site's reference list works, including those the statistics page does not cite. Use this when you hold a key (from get_prevalence, list_studies or a list_chart_data row) and need to cite that one study; use list_studies instead to discover keys or browse sources by topic, and get_citation instead to cite the dyscalculia.io compilation itself. An unknown key returns an error with similar keys and the keys the statistics page cites.

key.description: Exact reference key, case-sensitive, e.g. shalev2000, grosstsur1996, ncesDigest20430. Required.

name: get_reference
title: Get one full reference
